formula.observation: p_obs = center from observed depth ROI; t_obs=p_obs-R[:,0]*depth, depth=0.02
formula.legacy_tool: T_W_tool = T_W_candidate * T_candidate_tool; tool translation offset in candidate x = depth - old_pad_z
formula.legacy_correction: delta_h=max(0,table_z + old_collision_envelope + clearance - T_W_tool_preliminary[2,3]); t_z <- t_z + delta_h
formula.IP140: R_G=R_candidate, G_origin=p=t+R[:,0]*depth; this p is distal tip-plane midpoint, not IP140 pad center
formula.IP140_pad_faces: G x in [-0.060,0], z in [-0.010,+0.010], y=-q_left or +q_right; effective-face centers at x=-0.030
formula.roundtrip: G->F->G checks inverse matrix multiplication and registration only; no object-contact geometry is a constraint of that check

facts: The saved observed_proposal observation.contact_center_world is unchanged by legacy correction; policy_input.candidate_world is written after correction.
engineering_proposal_height_adjustment_m is computed after pure observation using frozen old Robotiq geometry/width-dependent pad offset, not by observed_proposal.

The original freezer reapplies the stored correction to a newly reconstructed observation candidate so it matches the historical already-adjusted policy exactly; it is not a second addition to an already-adjusted candidate.
The smoke02 freezer selected paired original slots 4/6,16/18,32/34 by common v52r2 intent lineage; new IP140 results were not inputs to that selection.
Old Robotiq candidate p maps to two pad collision-box centers midpoint; IP140 candidate p maps to its distal plane midpoint; these physical semantics differ.
The archived Robot collision envelope pertains to rq_* Robotiq links, including pad half-length; no IP140 asset occurs in that source evidence.
inferences: The correction has an executor-specific geometric rationale and is not a measurement invariant. Reusing its numerical values as an IP140 observation correction has no validated derivation in these files.

A single-variable future correction should be considered at the legacy observation-to-execution adaptation layer, not by relabeling depth or silently editing F_T_G. Historical candidates and billed failure must remain immutable.
Undoing legacy correction recovers the original observation-derived p without changing depth/R/width, but by itself does not prove physical IP140 pad-center placement or successful grasp.
not_verified: No new dynamics, contact force, grasp outcome or admission result for any corrected candidate.
No guarantee that undoing legacy correction alone yields safe whole-robot/table clearance through the trajectory.
No inference that initial scene center equals settled center; both are separately reported.
Archived collision-envelope calculation was not rerun as an engine operation; its saved numerical result is read and bound by SHA.

geometry_evidence.recorded_scope: Saved plan and official robot geometry only; no object load/physics step/episode

recorded_proposal.limitation: This is engineering-only candidate construction. GraspNet t/R/depth semantics and all old P3 candidates remain unchanged. Static clearance does not prove dynamic clearance.

12: def grasp_to_tool(T_world_camera, candidate, pad_center_z):
13:     """^A T_B maps B coordinates to A. GraspNet contact=t+R[:,0]*depth."""
14:     candidate = np.asarray(candidate, dtype=float)
15:     T_camera_grasp = transform(candidate[4:13].reshape(3, 3), candidate[13:16])
16:     # Gripper +z is approach; +y is closing. Its +x is GraspNet -z.
17:     R_grasp_tool = np.array([[0., 0., 1.], [0., 1., 0.], [-1., 0., 0.]])
18:     T_grasp_tool = transform(R_grasp_tool, [candidate[3]-pad_center_z, 0., 0.])
19:     return np.asarray(T_world_camera) @ T_camera_grasp @ T_grasp_tool

32: def observed_proposal(points_world, yaw, table_z, workspace):
33:     cloud = np.asarray(points_world).reshape(-1,3)
34:     lo, hi = np.asarray(workspace[0]), np.asarray(workspace[1])
35:     selected = cloud[np.isfinite(cloud).all(axis=1) & (cloud>lo).all(axis=1) & (cloud<hi).all(axis=1)]
36:     if len(selected)<30:
37:         raise ValueError('empty_observation')
38:     bmin, bmax = np.quantile(selected, [.01,.99], axis=0)
39:     closing = np.array([np.cos(yaw), np.sin(yaw), 0.])
40:     approach = np.array([0.,0.,-1.])
41:     rotation = np.column_stack((approach, closing, np.cross(approach, closing)))
42:     width = float(np.ptp(selected @ closing))
43:     center = (bmin+bmax)/2
44:     center[2] = table_z + (bmax[2]-table_z)*.55
45:     depth = .02
46:     candidate = np.r_[1., width+.015, .02, depth, rotation.ravel(), center-approach*depth, -1.]
47:     return candidate, dict(point_count=len(selected), bbox_min=bmin.tolist(), bbox_max=bmax.tolist(),
48:                            estimated_object_width_m=width, contact_center_world=center.tolist(),
49:                            policy_inputs='observed depth point cloud, fixed table/workspace, fixed requested yaw; no body pose or instance/physics labels')

197: def driver_for_width(width, manifest=None):
198:     m=manifest or json.loads(MANIFEST.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
199:     cal=m['opening_calibration']
200:     lo,hi=cal[-1]['inner_pad_gap_m'],cal[0]['inner_pad_gap_m']
201:     if width<lo-1e-9 or width>hi+1e-9: raise ValueError(f'width {width} outside [{lo},{hi}]; no silent clipping')
202:     return float(np.interp(width,[x['inner_pad_gap_m'] for x in cal][::-1],[x['driver_rad'] for x in cal][::-1]))
